quote_zh: 1、2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成 ... 称取13.1g(0.05mol)2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯于500mL四口烧瓶中，加入180mL四氯化碳，升温回流，滴加8.8g(0.055mol)溴素，保温反应4h，停止反应，冷却、过滤，滤液浓缩得淡黄色固体15g，收率88％。
arithmetic_check: Charges: methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoate 13.1 g / 0.05 mol implies MW 262.0 against C10H11ClO4S = 262.71, low by 0.27%, rounding. Bromine 8.8 g / 0.055 mol implies 160.0 against Br2 = 159.81, high by 0.12%, rounding. No molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure: limiting input 0.0500 mol of the ester (the bromine is 0.055 mol, 1.1 equivalents); the product as drawn is C10H10BrClO4S, MW 341.60; theoretical 0.0500 x 341.60 = 17.08 g; the printed 15 g is 87.8% of theory against a printed yield of 88%. CLOSES to within rounding, so no mass_balance_implausible. First step of the section, so there is no preceding output to compare against and scale_discontinuity cannot arise. Numbers recorded exactly as printed. Caveat for A5: the 88% is a mass yield on the crude concentrated filtrate, since no purity, melting point, NMR or chromatographic check is given for the 15 g of solid, and the section prints no purity for any charge either, so nothing in this step is purity-corrected.

quote_zh: 2、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成 ... 将5.4g(0.1mol)甲醇钠称于120mLDMF中，加入四口烧瓶中，冷却至15℃，滴加三氟乙醇，滴毕后，加入2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯，室温下反应过夜，蒸出DMF，冷却后加入100mL乙醇，滴加10％NaOH溶液40mL，滴毕后回流1h，反应完毕，蒸出乙醇，用HCL调至酸性，黄色固体析出，收率为83.2％。
arithmetic_check: NO MASS BALANCE IS POSSIBLE FOR THIS STEP, AND THAT IS A PROPERTY OF THE PATENT RATHER THAN OF THE ARITHMETIC. The only mass/mole pair printed anywhere in the step is sodium methoxide 5.4 g / 0.1 mol, implying MW 54.0 against CH3ONa = 54.02: correct, so no molar_mass_inconsistent. Everything a closure would need is absent: the benzylic bromide is charged by name with no mass and no mole count, the trifluoroethanol is charged dropwise with no mass, volume or mole count, the product is never named in the prose, and no product mass is given. The step prints a yield of 83.2% and nothing to compute it from. Both limbs of the mass_balance_implausible check require a stated product mass, so neither can be evaluated, and the flag is deliberately NOT raised: this is a hole in the record, not a demonstrated inconsistency, and marking it as one would mislead A5. What the printed numbers do support, for use at step 3: step 1 isolated 15 g of the bromide, which at the drawn C10H10BrClO4S (MW 341.60) is 0.0439 mol, and 83.2% of that is 0.0365 mol, about 12.7 g, of the acid at C11H10ClF3O5S (MW 346.70). The step's own scale is also unstated; its only mole count, 0.1 mol of sodium methoxide, is twice the 0.05 mol of step 1, but with the limiting-reagent charge absent this cannot be evaluated as a scale_discontinuity here, and that flag is raised on step 3, where a charge is actually printed. Numbers recorded exactly as printed and no quantity is carried in from step 1 or from anywhere else.

quote_zh: 3、环磺酮的合成 ... 将34.6g(0.1mol)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸溶于200ml中二氯甲烷，滴加60g(0.5mol)的氯化亚砜，回流反应5h，然后整出溶剂和过量的氯化亚砜，残液加入150ml乙腈溶解，然后加入13.44g(0.12mol)1,3-环己二酮和4滴丙酮氰醇。室温搅拌16h。过滤，滤液浓缩，加入150ml水，用2mol/L盐酸调至PH＝2后，过滤、干燥，得黄色固体35g。收率为80％。
arithmetic_check: Charges: the acid 34.6 g / 0.1 mol implies MW 346.0 against C11H10ClF3O5S = 346.70, low by 0.2%, rounding. Thionyl chloride 60 g / 0.5 mol implies 120.0 against SOCl2 = 118.97, high by 0.87%, inside the tolerance the other pairs in this section sit at, so no flag. Cyclohexane-1,3-dione 13.44 g / 0.12 mol implies 112.0 against C6H8O2 = 112.13, correct. No molar_mass_inconsistent on any pair. Product closure: limiting input 0.100 mol of the acid, the dione being 0.12 mol or 1.2 equivalents and the thionyl chloride 5 equivalents; the product as drawn is C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.81; theoretical 0.100 x 440.81 = 44.08 g; the printed 35 g is 79.4% of theory against a printed yield of 80%. CLOSES to within rounding, so no mass_balance_implausible. Continuity: DOES NOT CLOSE, and this is the section's one arithmetic flag. This step charges 34.6 g / 0.1 mol of the step 2 product, but step 1 isolated 15 g of the bromide (0.0439 mol at MW 341.60) and step 2's own stated 83.2% takes that to at most 0.0365 mol, about 12.7 g, of this acid. The charge is therefore about 2.7 times the material the section's own preceding steps could have produced, and the molar scale doubles from 0.05 mol at step 1 to 0.1 mol here with nothing in the text explaining a rescale. Flag raised: scale_discontinuity. Two quantities in this step are not numbers and cannot enter any balance: the acetone cyanohydrin is dosed as 4滴, four drops, and the hydrochloric acid is given only as 2 mol/L with no volume. All numbers recorded exactly as printed and none inferred.
